learnings: API failures should not block the overall verdict when critical files (PKGBUILD, .install, patches) are successfully reviewed; distinguish between 'incomplete coverage due to tool error' and 'security concerns found'
Implement retry logic or model fallback when LLM API calls fail, especially for low-risk files like .gitignore and .SRCINFO
Prioritize security-critical files (PKGBUILD, .install, patches) in batched reviews to ensure they are analyzed even if API errors occur on less important files
